 1   Resolution Number 4660, by Senator Funke, 

 2   congratulating the Victor Marching Blue Devils 

 3   upon the occasion of capturing First Place in 

 4   the National Class at the 2015 New York State 

 5   Field Band Conference Championships.

 6                ACTING PRESIDENT AKSHAR:   Senator 

 7   Funke.

 8                SENATOR FUNKE:   Thank you, 

 9   Mr. President, for allowing me the opportunity 

10   to recognize the Victor Marching Blue Devils, 

11   National Class champions in the New York State 

12   Field Band Conference.  At the 42nd Annual 

13   New York State Field Band Conference 

14   Championships, held last November at Syracuse 

15   University, Victor placed first out of seven 

16   National Class bands.

17                The Victor Marching Blue Devils are 

18   celebrating their 34th season in the New York 

19   State Field Band Conference, with 96 students in 

20   Grades 7 through 12.  And this year's field 

21   show, called "Light to Dark, Dark to Light," 

22   earned a score of 98.4 out of 100, the highest 

23   ever achieved in the band's history.  

24                Six other bands competed in 

25   Victor's class, with 52 bands competing across 


                                                                1929

 1   six categories all together.  And Victor was the 

 2   smallest band in the National Class.  

 3                Under the direction of Eric 

 4   Everhart, Victor went undefeated in the New York 

 5   State Field Band Conference, receiving four First 

 6   Place finishes and one Outstanding rating.  

 7                You know, Victor High School has 

 8   produced state champions and sectional champions

10   to football.  Marching bands, by the way, adhere 

11   to that same dedication, teamwork, precision and 

12   work ethic as all of those other teams, and I

14                So I want to thank you,

10   those survival skills that men should have.  And

12   in England and came to the United States, was

14   those survival skills to give you the 

15   self-confidence to survive in this world.  Which
